Subject: PO vs Card — procurement & next steps

Hi Sophie — great to meet on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your procurement team has what they need: 

1) High-level ask from FinOpsCo: Redwood will provide hosted inference for internal product personalization (~300k tokens/month to start), plus a short pilot for batch embeddings.

2) Commercial path question: you mentioned AP prefers POs for invoices > $50k/year and card for smaller deals. Can you confirm the threshold and whether a credit-card purchase is acceptable for the initial pilot (~$6k/month) while we complete vendor onboarding?

3) Vendor onboarding items we usually provide: W-9, SOC 2 summary, company info, and vendor form. I attached a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.pdf) and our typical vendor onboarding checklist. Could you confirm if your procurement team needs any additional documents or a particular vendor form?

4) Marketplace option: you asked whether Redwood is available in the FinOpsCo marketplace. We are not yet listed there, but we can prioritize a marketplace listing if that would materially speed procurement. Is that preferable to your team vs. doing a direct vendor onboarding?

Proposed next steps:
- Sophie: confirm PO threshold and whether card/p-card is acceptable for pilot.
- FinOps AP: share any vendor_request_form or portal link.
- Redwood: I’ll send the W-9 and SOC 2 summary and prepare a short SOW + DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Thanks — copying Lauren (solutions) and Aditya (platform) to help with technical and billing questions.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@finopsco.com>

Cc: AP Team <ap-finops@finopsco.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO vs Card — procurement & next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- PO threshold: Our formal policy is that any vendor with expected spend over $50k/year requires a PO and 2-3 week vendor onboarding. For pilots under that threshold we typically allow payment via procurement card (P-card) or a purchase order depending on business owner preference.

- Vendor onboarding: Please complete our vendor request form (attached: FinOpsCo_vendor_request_form.xlsx). Procurement will need a completed form, a W-9, and evidence of SOC 2 or equivalent security posture (a SOC 2 summary is fine). There is also a short vendor questionnaire for cloud vendors — I can share that after you complete the form.

- Marketplace: If Redwood were in our marketplace, procurement can buy via marketplace and bypass some vendor setup. That usually speeds things up by 1-2 weeks. If you can get on the marketplace, that would be ideal.

- Billing entity & invoicing cadence: Who will be the billing entity? Redwood Inc. / Redwood Inference? Also, do you invoice monthly or net-30? We prefer monthly invoices and net-30 payment terms; shorter payment windows may require a PO and finance sign-off.

I’ve cc’d AP for visibility — @AP Team, please confirm the vendor form is complete and whether any additional tax forms are required.

Thanks,

Sophie Miller
Sr. FinOps Manager | FinOpsCo
sophie.miller@finopsco.com

Attachments: FinOpsCo_vendor_request_form.xlsx
